fact: 埃米尔·卢贝（Émile Loubet）担任法兰西第三共和国总统，任期1899—1906年，故1901年全年在任的法国总统为卢贝。

sources.title: Élysée.fr — Les présidents de la République

fact: 巴黎航空俱乐部的德意志奖（Prix Deutsch de la Meurthe）：奖金10万法郎，由德意志（de la Meurthe）设立，规则为1900—1904年每年5月1日至10月1日间，飞艇自圣克鲁起飞场升空、不触地、以自身动力绕埃菲尔铁塔轴线一圈并在30分钟内返回出发点。

sources.title: My Airships; The Story of My Life（Alberto Santos-Dumont）Project Gutenberg eBook No. 42344
sources.quote: This prize of 100,000 francs, founded by M. Deutsch (de la Meurthe), a member of the Paris Aéro Club, was to be awarded by the Scientific Commission of that organisation to the first dirigible balloon or air-ship that between 1st May and 1st October 1900, 1901, 1902, 1903, and 1904 should rise from the Parc d'Aerostation of the Aéro Club at St Cloud and, without touching ground and by its own self-contained means on board alone, describe a closed curve in such a way that the axis of the Eiffel Tower should be within the interior of the circuit, and return to the point of departure in the maximum time of half-an-hour.

fact: 桑托斯·迪蒙于1901年10月完成绕埃菲尔铁塔飞行并赢得10万法郎德意志奖；其友人来信以“自1901年10月19日起，游戏改名为‘人会飞了！’”记其事。

sources.title: My Airships; The Story of My Life（Alberto Santos-Dumont）Project Gutenberg eBook No. 42344 — 佩德罗来信
sources.quote: You were right not to pay the forfeit; it is M. Deutsch who has paid it in your stead. Bravo! you well deserve the 100,000 franc prize. "They play the old game now more than ever at home, but the name has been changed and the rules modified--since October 19, 1901. They call it now 'Man flies!'..." -- Your friend, PEDRO.

fact: 桑托斯·迪蒙1901年另设“桑托斯·迪蒙奖”（以其1900年所获奖金年息4000法郎为本金）：1901年5月1日—10月1日期间自圣克鲁起飞、绕埃菲尔铁塔返回且不触地者获奖，若1901年无人夺得则逐年延期。

sources.title: My Airships; The Story of My Life（Alberto Santos-Dumont）Project Gutenberg eBook No. 42344 — 桑托斯·迪蒙个人奖
sources.quote: The Santos-Dumont prize shall be awarded to the aeronaut, a member of the Paris Aéro Club, and not the founder of this prize, who between 1st May and 1st October 1901, starting from the Parc d'Aerostation of St Cloud, shall turn round the Eiffel Tower and come back to the starting-point, at the end of whatever time, without having touched ground, and by his self-contained means on board alone.

fact: 1901年7月12日，桑托斯·迪蒙5号飞艇自航空俱乐部场地起飞并返回（其自传插图目录所注日期）；获奖飞行中6号飞艇爬升至约1000英尺绕塔。
